A campus voice network by students, for students.

Tune In Campus is a student-run network that gives every voice a place to be heard.

We share short audio clips, interviews, event updates and open-mic moments, so you always know what is happening around you.

Everything on the network is student-made. If you have something to say, we have a microphone ready.

Ways to tune in

Audio clips

Quick episodes and teasers you can play between classes.

Student voices

Interviews and polls that put campus opinions first.

Live events

Open mics, launches and announcements, as they happen.

Have something to say?

Pitch an episode, join the team or suggest a topic. Everyone is welcome.
